integrity: The analytic argument and exact-rational program have been checked in the present same-model review. Independent scholarly and historical-priority validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns equal barycentric cap depths between zero and one half, not nonuniform truncations or later combinatorial phases. Exact affine-invariant profile and global monotonicity are proved along this family, not among all convex bodies.
title: The exact isotropic-constant profile of uniformly vertex-truncated simplices
